title: RHEL 9 passwords must have a 24 hours minimum password lifetime restriction in /etc/shadow.
source_xml:
<ns0:oval_definitions xmlns:ns0="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-definitions-5" xmlns:ns1="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-common-5" xmlns:ns2="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-definitions-5#independent" xmlns:ns3="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-definitions-5#unix"><ns0:generator>
        <ns1:product_name>Security Content Tool 1.9.0</ns1:product_name>
        <ns1:schema_version>5.11</ns1:schema_version>
        <ns1:timestamp>2026-06-25T09:43:57</ns1:timestamp>
      </ns0:generator>
      <ns0:definitions><ns0:definition id="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:def:230364" version="1" class="compliance">
          <ns0:metadata>
            <ns0:title>The operating system passwords must have a 24 hours/1 day minimum password lifetime restriction in /etc/shadow.</ns0:title>
            <ns0:description />
          </ns0:metadata>
          <ns0:criteria>
            <ns0:criterion test_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:tst:23036400" comment="Root does not have a minimum password age of 0 or blank" />
            <ns0:criterion test_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:tst:23036401" comment="Non-system users do not have a minimum password age of 0 or blank" />
          </ns0:criteria>
        </ns0:definition>
        <ns0:definition id="oval:mil.disa.stig.rhel9os:def:258105" version="1" class="compliance">
          <ns0:metadata>
            <ns0:title>RHEL-09-611080 - RHEL 9 passwords must have a 24 hours minimum password lifetime restriction in /etc/shadow.</ns0:title>
            <ns0:affected family="unix">
              <ns0:platform>Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9</ns0:platform>
            </ns0:affected>
            <ns0:description>Enforcing a minimum password lifetime helps to prevent repeated password changes to defeat the password reuse or history enforcement requirement. If users are allowed to immediately and continually change their password, the password could be repeatedly changed in a short period of time to defeat the organization's policy regarding password reuse.</ns0:description>
          </ns0:metadata>
          <ns0:criteria>
            <ns0:extend_definition definition_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:def:230364" />
          </ns0:criteria>
        </ns0:definition>
        </ns0:definitions><ns0:tests><ns2:textfilecontent54_test id="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:tst:23036400" version="1" check_existence="none_exist" check="all" comment="Root does not have a minimum password age of 0 or blank">
          <ns2:object object_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:obj:23036400" />
        </ns2:textfilecontent54_test>
        <ns3:password_test id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:tst:23036401" version="1" check_existence="none_exist" check="all" comment="Non-system users do not have a minimum password age of 0 or blank">
          <ns3:object object_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:obj:23036401" />
        </ns3:password_test>
        </ns0:tests><ns0:objects><ns2:textfilecontent54_object id="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:obj:23036400" version="1">
          <ns2:filepath datatype="string">/etc/shadow</ns2:filepath>
          <ns2:pattern operation="pattern match">^root:[^:]*:[^:]*:0*:</ns2:pattern>
          <ns2:instance datatype="int" operation="greater than or equal">1</ns2:instance>
        </ns2:textfilecontent54_object>
        <ns2:textfilecontent54_object id="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:obj:23036402" version="1">
          <ns2:filepath datatype="string">/etc/shadow</ns2:filepath>
          <ns2:pattern operation="pattern match">^([^:]*):[^:]*:[^:]*:0*:</ns2:pattern>
          <ns2:instance datatype="int" operation="greater than or equal">1</ns2:instance>
        </ns2:textfilecontent54_object>
        <ns2:textfilecontent54_object id="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:obj:23036403" version="1">
          <ns2:filepath datatype="string">/etc/passwd</ns2:filepath>
          <ns2:pattern datatype="string" operation="pattern match">^nobody:[^:]*:([0-9]+):</ns2:pattern>
          <ns2:instance datatype="int">1</ns2:instance>
        </ns2:textfilecontent54_object>
        <ns3:password_object id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:obj:23036401" version="2" comment="Users with a password age of zero minus system users">
          <ns3:username datatype="string" operation="equals" var_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:var:23036400" var_check="at least one" />
          <ns0:filter>oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:23036400</ns0:filter>
          <ns0:filter>oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:23036401</ns0:filter>
        </ns3:password_object>
        </ns0:objects><ns0:states><ns3:password_state id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:23036400" version="1">
          <ns3:user_id datatype="int" operation="less than">1000</ns3:user_id>
        </ns3:password_state>
        <ns3:password_state id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:23036401" version="1">
          <ns3:user_id datatype="int" operation="equals" var_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:var:23036401" var_check="all" />
        </ns3:password_state>
        </ns0:states><ns0:variables><ns0:local_variable id="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:var:23036400" version="1" datatype="string" comment="Usernames of users with a minimum password age of 0 or blank">
          <ns0:object_component object_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:obj:23036402" item_field="subexpression" />
        </ns0:local_variable>
        <ns0:local_variable id="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:var:23036401" version="1" datatype="int" comment="UID for user nobody">
          <ns0:object_component object_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.ind:obj:23036403" item_field="subexpression" />
        </ns0:local_variable>
        </ns0:variables></ns0:oval_definitions>
